title: Figure 5: Qualitative picture of spin-transfer torque in an Fb/N/Fa trilayer
description: Two-panel schematic captioned 'Figure 5. Qualitative Picture of STT. (a) For left-going electrons magnetic moments (thin arrows) of both Fa and Fb are rotated clockwise. (b) For right-going electrons the directions of the torques (thick arrows) on Fa and Fb are reversed. (Reference 47)'. Each panel shows layers Fb, N and Fa with spin arrows, angle theta, x-y-z axes and an 'Electron Current' arrow.
